chuck.airborne.3.text: He punted him! He punted him!
chuck.airborne.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.airborne.4.text: Up, up, and OUT of here!
chuck.airborne.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.chase.1.text: He's on the run! Go get him!
chuck.chase.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.chase.2.text: Chase him down! Don't let him escape!
chuck.chase.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.chase.4.text: Run, baby, run! He's right behind you!
chuck.chase.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.comeback.1.text: THERE it is! The champ is BACK, baby!
chuck.comeback.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.comeback.2.text: That's the Juggernaut I remember! Vintage!
chuck.comeback.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.comeback.3.text: You can't teach that, Dale! That's muscle memory!
chuck.comeback.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.comeback.4.text: The old champ's still got the arm! Still got the arm!
chuck.comeback.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.count.1.text: The count's on! Get up! Get up!
chuck.count.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.decision.1.text: Going to the judges! It's in their hands now!
chuck.decision.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.decision.2.text: Both still standing! Judges, your call!
chuck.decision.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.decision.3.text: Close one, Dale! Could go either way!
chuck.decision.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.decision.4.text: That's a full sixty minutes of football! Er, three. Three minutes.
chuck.decision.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.desk.1.text: Dale, I have been waiting all week for this!
chuck.desk.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.desk.2.text: Chuck Kowalski here, and Dale, I am fired up!
chuck.desk.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.desk.3.text: These robots came to play tonight, Dale. I can feel it.
chuck.desk.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.desk.4.text: Big night, Dale. Big night. I barely slept.
chuck.desk.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.desk.5.text: I watched film on every one of these robots. Twice.
chuck.desk.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.drivedown.1.text: He's running in circles! Lost a drive!
chuck.drivedown.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.drivedown.2.text: One side's dead! He can't go straight!
chuck.drivedown.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.drivedown.3.text: He's limping! Only one side pushing!
chuck.drivedown.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.drivedown.4.text: Spinning in place! That's a bad ankle!
chuck.drivedown.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.fall.1.text: That robot used to own this place, Dale.
chuck.fall.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.fall.2.text: I know that look. You take a hit like that, you're never the same.
chuck.fall.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.fall.3.text: Stay down, champ. Just stay down.
chuck.fall.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.fire.1.text: IT'S ON FIRE! IT'S ON FIRE!
chuck.fire.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.flip.2.text: Turned him over like a fumble!
chuck.flip.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.flip.4.text: He's on his back! Get up!
chuck.flip.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.hit.3.text: That's a clean shot right there!
chuck.hit.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.hit.5.text: Somebody get that robot a helmet!
chuck.hit.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.huge.2.text: That is a hall of fame hit, Dale!
chuck.huge.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.huge.3.text: Call the trainer! Call the trainer!
chuck.huge.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.huge.4.text: I felt that one in my knees!
chuck.huge.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.huge.5.text: That's a SACK! That is a sack!
chuck.huge.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.1.text: You know, Dale, a robot is a lot like a lineman. Low center of gravity wins.
chuck.idle.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.2.text: These builders practice all year. That's dedication. That's heart.
chuck.idle.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.3.text: In my playing days, I would have loved a hammer like that Pulverizer.
chuck.idle.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.4.text: Driving a robot is all about vision. You gotta read the field.
chuck.idle.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.5.text: I talked to the teams in the pits. These folks are tough, Dale.
chuck.idle.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.6.text: Defense wins championships. Armor is defense. It's that simple.
chuck.idle.6.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.7.text: I've been hit hard, Dale. Real hard. Nothing like these robots, though.
chuck.idle.7.speaker: Chuck

chuck.idle.8.text: You gotta respect the hustle. Every robot out here earned its spot.
chuck.idle.8.speaker: Chuck

chuck.intro.1.text: This is a great matchup, Dale. Strength on strength.
chuck.intro.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.intro.2.text: Both teams look ready. I can feel it.
chuck.intro.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.intro.3.text: Gotta win the battle in the trenches here.
chuck.intro.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.intro.4.text: Watch the first ten seconds. That sets the tone.
chuck.intro.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.intro.5.text: Game faces on! Let's see what they got!
chuck.intro.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.panel.4.text: Panel's off! Go after that side!
chuck.panel.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pin.1.text: He's got him pinned! Drive, drive!
chuck.pin.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pin.2.text: He's carrying him like a fullback!
chuck.pin.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pin.3.text: Pinned! Push him to the hazards!
chuck.pin.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.down.1.text: OH! OH NO! The champ is upside down! It's on FIRE!
chuck.pro.down.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.down.2.text: That's not possible. Nobody hits the champ like that. Nobody.
chuck.pro.down.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.taste.1.text: That's a CHAMPION'S hit, Dale! That's why it's the champ!
chuck.pro.taste.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.taste.2.text: The champ's in victory formation! Just take a knee, baby!
chuck.pro.taste.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.taste.3.text: Put it in the trophy case! This dynasty is NOT done!
chuck.pro.taste.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.turn.1.text: Hold on! Listen to that bar wind up! Look out, champ!
chuck.pro.turn.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.pro.turn.2.text: It's coming! Juggernaut doesn't see it! LOOK OUT!
chuck.pro.turn.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.ramrod.2.text: The floor came up and got him!
chuck.ramrod.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.ramrod.3.text: Ooh, spikes from below! Cheap shot!
chuck.ramrod.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.righted.1.text: He's back up! What a comeback!
chuck.righted.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.righted.2.text: Back on his feet! Get in there!
chuck.righted.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.righted.3.text: He shook it off! Tough kid!
chuck.righted.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.righted.4.text: Righted! The drive is still alive!
chuck.righted.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.rookie.1.text: Love this rookie team. Hungry. Raw talent.
chuck.rookie.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.rookie.2.text: First time in the Box! Welcome to the big leagues!
chuck.rookie.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.rookie.3.text: The rookie's got heart, Dale. You can't coach heart.
chuck.rookie.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.rookie.4.text: Rookie season! I remember mine. I threw four interceptions.
chuck.rookie.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.rookie.5.text: Give this rookie a chance. They might surprise you.
chuck.rookie.5.speaker: Chuck

chuck.saw.2.text: The killsaws are in the game!
chuck.saw.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.saw.4.text: He drove right over the saws!
chuck.saw.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.smoke.4.text: Smoke coming out! He's hurt, Dale!
chuck.smoke.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spikes.1.text: Into the spikes! That's a body slam!
chuck.spikes.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spikes.2.text: He drove him right into the spikes!
chuck.spikes.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spikes.3.text: Rammed into the spike wall! Ugh!
chuck.spikes.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spikes.4.text: Up against the spikes! Bad spot!
chuck.spikes.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spinup.1.text: Listen to that weapon wind up!
chuck.spinup.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spinup.2.text: Spinner's up to speed! Look out!
chuck.spinup.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.spinup.4.text: Hear that? That is pure power!
chuck.spinup.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.start.3.text: And they come off the line hard!
chuck.start.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.timelow.1.text: Thirty seconds! This is crunch time!
chuck.timelow.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.timelow.2.text: Thirty left! Leave it all on the field!
chuck.timelow.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.timelow.3.text: Under thirty! Gotta make a play!
chuck.timelow.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.timelow.4.text: Clock's running down! Go, go, go!
chuck.timelow.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.upset.1.text: Upset! We've got an upset brewing!
chuck.upset.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.upset.3.text: Nobody gave him a chance! Look at him now!
chuck.upset.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.upset.4.text: This is a Cinderella story, Dale!
chuck.upset.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.wall.1.text: Into the boards! What a check!
chuck.wall.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.wall.3.text: Pinned on the sideline! Good effort!
chuck.wall.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.wall.4.text: He ran him right out of bounds!
chuck.wall.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.weapondown.1.text: The weapon's dead! No offense left!
chuck.weapondown.1.speaker: Chuck

chuck.weapondown.2.text: Weapon's down! Gotta play defense now!
chuck.weapondown.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.weapondown.3.text: Lost the weapon! No passing game!
chuck.weapondown.3.speaker: Chuck

chuck.weapondown.4.text: That weapon is done for the day!
chuck.weapondown.4.speaker: Chuck

chuck.wheel.2.text: He lost a wheel! That's an injury!
chuck.wheel.2.speaker: Chuck

chuck.wheel.3.text: Wheel's gone! That's a blown knee!
chuck.wheel.3.speaker: Chuck

dale.airborne.1.text: And it's flying! Robots can fly now!
dale.airborne.1.speaker: Dale

dale.bumper.2.text: Don't go anywhere. BotBox will be right back.
dale.bumper.2.speaker: Dale

dale.bumper.3.text: Stick around. More robot violence after this.
dale.bumper.3.speaker: Dale

dale.bumper.4.text: We'll be right back, after a word from people with money.
dale.bumper.4.speaker: Dale

dale.chase.1.text: And the chase is on. Run, robot, run.
dale.chase.1.speaker: Dale

dale.chase.2.text: One's running, one's chasing. It's a cartoon.
dale.chase.2.speaker: Dale

dale.chase.3.text: This is a chase scene now.
dale.chase.3.speaker: Dale

dale.chase.4.text: Look at it run. Smart, honestly.
dale.chase.4.speaker: Dale

dale.comeback.1.text: Well, well. The old champ still remembers how to do that.
dale.comeback.1.speaker: Dale

dale.comeback.2.text: Two seasons in a storage unit, and it still hits like the rent is due.
dale.comeback.2.speaker: Dale

dale.comeback.3.text: I missed that sound. I'm not crying, it's the smoke.
dale.comeback.3.speaker: Dale

dale.comeback.4.text: Okay, I take back what I said about this comeback. Most of it.
dale.comeback.4.speaker: Dale

dale.count.2.text: Uh oh. We have a count.
dale.count.2.speaker: Dale

dale.count.3.text: It's not moving. Come on, little guy.
dale.count.3.speaker: Dale

dale.decision.1.text: And we're going to the judges. Fun.
dale.decision.1.speaker: Dale

dale.decision.2.text: Nobody's dead, so the judges decide.
dale.decision.2.speaker: Dale

dale.decision.3.text: Time for the judges. Everybody look nervous.
dale.decision.3.speaker: Dale

dale.decision.4.text: It's up to the judges. I'd bribe them, but they're honest.
dale.decision.4.speaker: Dale

dale.desk.1.text: Welcome to BotBox. I'm Dale Pruitt, and yes, this is my real job.
dale.desk.1.speaker: Dale

dale.desk.2.text: Good evening. I'm Dale Pruitt. Tonight, robots fight and I make jokes about it.
dale.desk.2.speaker: Dale

dale.desk.3.text: Welcome back to the Box. With me as always, the Cannon himself, Chuck Kowalski.
dale.desk.3.speaker: Dale

dale.desk.4.text: Hi, I'm Dale. My mom thinks I host a cooking show.
dale.desk.4.speaker: Dale

dale.desk.5.text: Tonight's robots have saws, hammers and flamethrowers. Well, no flamethrowers. Yet.
dale.desk.5.speaker: Dale

dale.drivedown.1.text: It's driving in circles. We've all been there.
dale.drivedown.1.speaker: Dale

dale.drivedown.2.text: Lost a drive side. Round and round we go.
dale.drivedown.2.speaker: Dale

dale.drivedown.3.text: It drives like a broken shopping cart.
dale.drivedown.3.speaker: Dale

dale.drivedown.4.text: Look at it spin. It's having a moment.
dale.drivedown.4.speaker: Dale

dale.fall.1.text: Ooh. That's the old champ. Hard to watch.
dale.fall.1.speaker: Dale

dale.fall.2.text: Remember when it used to win? I do. I miss it.
dale.fall.2.speaker: Dale

dale.fall.3.text: Down again. Somebody give that robot a hug.
dale.fall.3.speaker: Dale

dale.fire.1.text: And it's on fire. That's bad, right?
dale.fire.1.speaker: Dale

dale.fire.2.text: Something's cooking, and it's not dinner.
dale.fire.2.speaker: Dale

dale.flip.5.text: That's one way to see the ceiling.
dale.flip.5.speaker: Dale

dale.hit.1.text: Ooh, that one left a mark.
dale.hit.1.speaker: Dale

dale.hit.5.text: That's gonna need a bandage. A metal one.
dale.hit.5.speaker: Dale

dale.huge.3.text: Holy cow! Did you see that?
dale.huge.3.speaker: Dale

dale.huge.4.text: That is going in the highlight reel!
dale.huge.4.speaker: Dale

dale.huge.5.text: Oh, come on! That's just rude!
dale.huge.5.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.1.text: These builders spent a whole year on this. And a lot of duct tape.
dale.idle.1.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.2.text: Fun fact. Most of these robots were built in a garage. Most of these builders still live there.
dale.idle.2.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.3.text: I asked a builder how much his robot cost. He started crying.
dale.idle.3.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.4.text: If you're just joining us, robots are hitting each other. That's the show.
dale.idle.4.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.5.text: The Box is bulletproof Lexan. Which is good, because I'm sitting right here.
dale.idle.5.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.6.text: I tried to build a robot once. It's a lamp now.
dale.idle.6.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.7.text: The judges are watching closely. Well, two of them. One's eating a pretzel.
dale.idle.7.speaker: Dale

dale.idle.8.text: Somewhere, a mom is watching this and saying, please be careful, that's my son's robot.
dale.idle.8.speaker: Dale

dale.intro.1.text: Two robots, one Box. Let's see who blinks.
dale.intro.1.speaker: Dale

dale.intro.2.text: Look at these two. Somebody's going home in a bucket.
dale.intro.2.speaker: Dale

dale.intro.3.text: The builders look nervous. The robots look fine.
dale.intro.3.speaker: Dale

dale.intro.4.text: I like this matchup. I have no idea why.
dale.intro.4.speaker: Dale

dale.intro.5.text: Here we go. Keep your hands inside the Lexan.
dale.intro.5.speaker: Dale

dale.panel.1.text: There goes a piece. Anybody want that?
dale.panel.1.speaker: Dale

dale.panel.2.text: Armor's off. That's a souvenir now.
dale.panel.2.speaker: Dale

dale.panel.3.text: And a panel goes flying. Duck!
dale.panel.3.speaker: Dale

dale.panel.5.text: Lost some armor. Who needs it.
dale.panel.5.speaker: Dale

dale.pin.1.text: And now it's a piggyback ride.
dale.pin.1.speaker: Dale

dale.pin.2.text: That's not a hug. That's a hostage situation.
dale.pin.2.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.down.1.text: Oh no. Oh, no. It hit the ceiling. The champ hit the ceiling.
dale.pro.down.1.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.down.2.text: I... I don't have a joke. I don't have anything.
dale.pro.down.2.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.taste.1.text: Juggernaut is just toying with it now. This isn't a fight, it's a coronation.
dale.pro.taste.1.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.taste.2.text: Somebody start polishing the Giant Nut. Again.
dale.pro.taste.2.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.taste.3.text: Oh, that's mean. That's championship mean!
dale.pro.taste.3.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.turn.1.text: Wait. Wait, what is that bar doing?
dale.pro.turn.1.speaker: Dale

dale.pro.turn.2.text: Uh oh. That's not a spinner anymore. That's a jet engine.
dale.pro.turn.2.speaker: Dale

dale.pulverizer.1.text: And the Pulverizer makes a house call.
dale.pulverizer.1.speaker: Dale

dale.pulverizer.3.text: That's the Pulverizer. Nobody likes the Pulverizer.
dale.pulverizer.3.speaker: Dale

dale.ramrod.1.text: Floor spikes. The floor is angry.
dale.ramrod.1.speaker: Dale

dale.ramrod.2.text: And the ramrods give it a poke.
dale.ramrod.2.speaker: Dale

dale.righted.1.text: And it's back on its wheels. Look at that.
dale.righted.1.speaker: Dale

dale.righted.2.text: It got up! Good for you, buddy.
dale.righted.2.speaker: Dale

dale.righted.4.text: Back on its feet. Well, wheels.
dale.righted.4.speaker: Dale

dale.rookie.1.text: And here's our rookie team. Bless their hearts.
dale.rookie.1.speaker: Dale

dale.rookie.2.text: The rookies built this in a garage. You can tell.
dale.rookie.2.speaker: Dale

dale.rookie.3.text: First time in the Box. No pressure. Only everybody watching.
dale.rookie.3.speaker: Dale

dale.rookie.4.text: Rookies! Everybody be nice. For now.
dale.rookie.4.speaker: Dale

dale.rookie.5.text: I love a rookie. So much hope. So many loose bolts.
dale.rookie.5.speaker: Dale

dale.saw.3.text: Ooh, the saws got a taste.
dale.saw.3.speaker: Dale

dale.smoke.1.text: And now we have smoke. Love that.
dale.smoke.1.speaker: Dale

dale.smoke.2.text: I see smoke. Not a great sign.
dale.smoke.2.speaker: Dale

dale.smoke.3.text: It's smoking. It should really quit.
dale.smoke.3.speaker: Dale

dale.smoke.4.text: Smoke signals. It's asking for help.
dale.smoke.4.speaker: Dale

dale.spikes.1.text: Into the spikes. That's a no from me.
dale.spikes.1.speaker: Dale

dale.spinup.1.text: Hear that? That's the sound of trouble.
dale.spinup.1.speaker: Dale

dale.spinup.2.text: And the spinner's winding up. Uh oh.
dale.spinup.2.speaker: Dale

dale.spinup.3.text: That whine means somebody's gonna cry.
dale.spinup.3.speaker: Dale

dale.start.2.text: Here we go. Try not to blink.
dale.start.2.speaker: Dale

dale.start.3.text: And they're moving. That's step one.
dale.start.3.speaker: Dale

dale.start.5.text: And the fight is on. Finally.
dale.start.5.speaker: Dale

dale.timelow.2.text: Half a minute to go. Make it count.
dale.timelow.2.speaker: Dale

dale.upset.2.text: Upset alert! I did not see this coming.
dale.upset.2.speaker: Dale

dale.upset.3.text: Folks, this was not in the script.
dale.upset.3.speaker: Dale

dale.wall.1.text: And into the wall. Walls win again.
dale.wall.1.speaker: Dale

dale.wall.3.text: Boom. Say hi to the wall.
dale.wall.3.speaker: Dale

dale.wall.4.text: Parked it. Right in the wall.
dale.wall.4.speaker: Dale

dale.weapondown.1.text: And the weapon just quit. Relatable.
dale.weapondown.1.speaker: Dale

dale.weapondown.2.text: Weapon's down. Now it's a very angry box.
dale.weapondown.2.speaker: Dale

dale.weapondown.4.text: No more weapon. Time for plan B.
dale.weapondown.4.speaker: Dale

dale.wheel.1.text: And that's a wheel. A loose wheel.
dale.wheel.1.speaker: Dale

dale.whiff.1.text: And a swing and a miss.
dale.whiff.1.speaker: Dale

dale.whiff.3.text: That was a very aggressive nothing.
dale.whiff.3.speaker: Dale

dale.whiff.4.text: Swinging at the air. Bold strategy.
dale.whiff.4.speaker: Dale

jenna.champ.1.text: You did it! You won the Giant Nut! How does it feel?
jenna.champ.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.champ.2.text: BotBox champions! Oh my gosh! Say something!
jenna.champ.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.champ.3.text: Champions! Can you guys even lift that thing?
jenna.champ.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.comeback.1.text: Juggernaut wins again! Two seasons ago this robot was a box of scrap. How does this feel?
jenna.comeback.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.comeback.2.text: I'm here with Team Juggernaut, and folks, the old champ is climbing! Talk to me!
jenna.comeback.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.comeback.3.text: From a storage unit to the winner's circle! What's going through your head right now?
jenna.comeback.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.fall.1.text: Stunner tonight: former champ Juggernaut crashes out in the first round.
jenna.fall.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.fall.2.text: Two more sponsors walk away from Team Juggernaut.
jenna.fall.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.fall.3.text: Juggernaut has dropped out of the rankings entirely.
jenna.fall.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.fall.4.text: Team Juggernaut has sold its famous disk. Yes, that disk.
jenna.fall.4.speaker: Jenna

jenna.fall.5.text: Another loss for the former champ. It just can't buy a win.
jenna.fall.5.speaker: Jenna

jenna.final.1.text: This is it, the final! How are you feeling right now?
jenna.final.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.final.2.text: One more fight for the Giant Nut! Are you nervous?
jenna.final.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.final.3.text: It's the final, guys! Any last words before you go in?
jenna.final.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.lose.1.text: Tough loss. What happened out there?
jenna.lose.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.lose.2.text: Aw, I'm so sorry, guys. What went wrong?
jenna.lose.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.lose.3.text: That was rough. Are you gonna rebuild?
jenna.lose.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.lose.4.text: You fought hard out there. What's next for the team?
jenna.lose.4.speaker: Jenna

jenna.pits.1.text: I'm down in the pits, where the rookie team is scrambling to get this thing ready!
jenna.pits.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.pits.2.text: Hey Dale! I'm in the pits, and there are tools everywhere. Like, everywhere!
jenna.pits.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.pits.3.text: I'm here with our rookies. They've got duct tape, a drill, and about four minutes!
jenna.pits.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.pits.4.text: Down here in the pits, you can smell the solder! It is so exciting!
jenna.pits.4.speaker: Jenna

jenna.rematch.text: This is the rematch everybody wanted. Juggernaut against the robot that broke it. Are you ready?
jenna.rematch.speaker: Jenna

jenna.win.1.text: I'm here with the winners! How does it feel?
jenna.win.1.speaker: Jenna

jenna.win.2.text: Oh my gosh, you guys did it! Tell me everything!
jenna.win.2.speaker: Jenna

jenna.win.3.text: What a fight! Was that the plan all along?
jenna.win.3.speaker: Jenna

jenna.win.4.text: Congratulations! Did you think you could win that one?
jenna.win.4.speaker: Jenna

vic.act.championship.text: This is it! One Box, one Giant Nut, and one score to settle... the BotBox CHAMPIONSHIP!
vic.act.championship.speaker: Vic

vic.act.regionals.text: The cameras are rolling, the stands are filling up... welcome to the BotBox REGIONALS!
vic.act.regionals.speaker: Vic

vic.act.show.text: Prime time, ladies and gentlemen! Every seat is full, every camera is live... this is BOTBOX!
vic.act.show.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.blenderella.text: From Orlando, Florida, a one hundred and twenty pound pink shell spinner... BLENDERELLA!
vic.bot.blenderella.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.blue-screen.text: From Seattle, Washington, a sixty pound flipper. Press any key... BLUE SCREEN!
vic.bot.blue-screen.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.buzz-off.text: From Sacramento, California, a beekeeper with a grudge and a two hundred and twenty pound horizontal spinner... BUZZ OFF!
vic.bot.buzz-off.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.buzzkill.text: From Gainesville, Florida, a one hundred and twenty pound horizontal spinner that ends the party... BUZZKILL!
vic.bot.buzzkill.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.chop-suey.text: From San Jose, California, a two hundred and twenty pound pneumatic axe. Number nine, extra spicy... CHOP SUEY!
vic.bot.chop-suey.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.ctrl-alt-defeat.text: From Redmond, Washington, tech support's one hundred and twenty pound drum spinner... CTRL-ALT-DEFEAT!
vic.bot.ctrl-alt-defeat.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.dial-up.text: From Columbus, Ohio, a sixty pound drum spinner that takes forever to connect... DIAL-UP!
vic.bot.dial-up.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.doorstop.text: From Fresno, California, a two hundred and twenty pound wedge made from a door hinge and pure optimism... DOORSTOP!
vic.bot.doorstop.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.flapjack.text: From Portland, Oregon, a two hundred and twenty pound flipper. Breakfast is served... FLAPJACK!
vic.bot.flapjack.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.frisbee-of-doom.text: From Boulder, Colorado, a three hundred and forty pound shell spinner. Heads up... FRISBEE OF DOOM!
vic.bot.frisbee-of-doom.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.general-discontent.text: From Detroit, Michigan, a two hundred and twenty pound horizontal spinner with a complaint... GENERAL DISCONTENT!
vic.bot.general-discontent.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.gigawatt.text: From Phoenix, Arizona, a three hundred and forty pound drum spinner that dims the lights... GIGAWATT!
vic.bot.gigawatt.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.homewrecker.text: From Bakersfield, California, a two hundred and twenty pound spinning steel shell... HOMEWRECKER!
vic.bot.homewrecker.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.knuckle-sandwich.text: From Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, three hundred and forty pounds of rammer. Today's special... KNUCKLE SANDWICH!
vic.bot.knuckle-sandwich.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.lawn-dart.text: From Modesto, California, a two hundred and twenty pound vertical spinner that wobbles like a shopping cart... LAWN DART!
vic.bot.lawn-dart.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.lunchbox.text: From Madison, Wisconsin, five sophomores and a sixty pound wedge... LUNCHBOX!
vic.bot.lunchbox.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.meatloaf.text: From Omaha, Nebraska, a three hundred and forty pound flipper. Seconds, anyone? MEATLOAF!
vic.bot.meatloaf.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.megahurtz.text: From Sunnyvale, California, a two hundred and twenty pound vertical spinner, no warranty included... MEGAHURTZ!
vic.bot.megahurtz.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.nervous-wreck.text: From Cambridge, Massachusetts, a one hundred and twenty pound vertical spinner that can't drive straight... NERVOUS WRECK!
vic.bot.nervous-wreck.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.paperweight.text: From Scranton, Pennsylvania, a sixty pound lifter made from a three hole punch... PAPERWEIGHT!
vic.bot.paperweight.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.prune-juice.text: From Sun City, Arizona, a one hundred and twenty pound axe that keeps things moving... PRUNE JUICE!
vic.bot.prune-juice.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.red-tape.text: From Arlington, Virginia, a three hundred and forty pound lifter. Please take a number... RED TAPE!
vic.bot.red-tape.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.shrapnel-sam.text: From Mobile, Alabama, a sixty pound steel shell spinner, built by father and son... SHRAPNEL SAM!
vic.bot.shrapnel-sam.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.snowplow.text: From Buffalo, New York, two hundred and twenty pounds of steel wedge and bad weather... SNOWPLOW!
vic.bot.snowplow.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.soccer-mom.text: From Naperville, Illinois, a one hundred and twenty pound lifter shaped like a minivan... SOCCER MOM!
vic.bot.soccer-mom.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.spatula.text: From Austin, Texas, a diner cook's one hundred and twenty pound flipper. Order up... SPATULA!
vic.bot.spatula.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.tax-audit.text: From Hartford, Connecticut, an accountant's two hundred and twenty pound pneumatic axe... TAX AUDIT!
vic.bot.tax-audit.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.terminal-velocity.text: From Boston, Massachusetts... undefeated. A titanium bar spinning at highway speed. The robot that ended a dynasty... TERMINAL VELOCITY!
vic.bot.terminal-velocity.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.the-contractor.text: From Las Vegas, Nevada, a three hundred and forty pound axe that shows up late... THE CONTRACTOR!
vic.bot.the-contractor.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.tooth-fairy.text: From Asheville, North Carolina, a dentist's sixty pound horizontal spinner... TOOTH FAIRY!
vic.bot.tooth-fairy.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.trash-panda.text: From Stockton, California, a two hundred and twenty pound spiked rammer that eats whatever you leave lying around... TRASH PANDA!
vic.bot.trash-panda.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.undertow.text: From Pensacola, Florida, a two hundred and twenty pound lifter that drags you under... UNDERTOW!
vic.bot.undertow.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.wreckoning.text: From Tulsa, Oklahoma, a three hundred and forty pound vertical spinner. Pray it misses... WRECKONING!
vic.bot.wreckoning.speaker: Vic

vic.bot.y2kill.text: From San Jose, California, a sixty pound vertical spinner. The world didn't end, but you will... Y2KILL!
vic.bot.y2kill.speaker: Vic

vic.champion.text: Ladies and gentlemen... your BotBox champion, and the winner of the Giant Nut...
vic.champion.speaker: Vic

vic.comeback.text: From a storage unit in Oakland to the top of the world... the comeback is COMPLETE!
vic.comeback.speaker: Vic

vic.decision.text: Ladies and gentlemen... we go to the judges.
vic.decision.speaker: Vic

vic.final.open.text: In one square, the robot that fell. In the other, the robot that broke it. Two seasons in the making... this is the REMATCH!
vic.final.open.speaker: Vic

vic.ko.2.text: Down and OUT! It's a knockout!
vic.ko.2.speaker: Vic

vic.lastbot.text: The last robot moving... and your rumble winner...
vic.lastbot.speaker: Vic

vic.open.1.text: From Treasure Island in San Francisco... this is BOTBOX!
vic.open.1.speaker: Vic

vic.open.2.text: Live from the steel cage on Treasure Island... welcome to BOTBOX!
vic.open.2.speaker: Vic

vic.open.3.text: Eight robots. One Box. One Giant Nut. From San Francisco... this is BOTBOX!
vic.open.3.speaker: Vic

vic.open.4.text: Sparks will fly, steel will bend... from Treasure Island, this is BOTBOX!
vic.open.4.speaker: Vic

vic.player.comeback.1.text: Once the king of the Box, rebuilt from scrap in an Oakland storage unit...
vic.player.comeback.1.speaker: Vic

vic.player.comeback.2.text: They sold the disk. They lost the sponsors. They kept the name...
vic.player.comeback.2.speaker: Vic

vic.player.comeback.3.text: Knocked out, counted out, written off... and still here. The former champion...
vic.player.comeback.3.speaker: Vic

vic.player.comeback.4.text: Bent, patched, and nowhere near finished... the fallen champion...
vic.player.comeback.4.speaker: Vic

vic.player.intro.1.text: A rookie team, straight out of the garage, making their very first trip into the Box...
vic.player.intro.1.speaker: Vic

vic.player.intro.2.text: Built on a kitchen table, held together with hope and hex bolts... the rookies bring you...
vic.player.intro.2.speaker: Vic

vic.player.intro.3.text: They've never been in the Box before, but they did not come here to lose...
vic.player.intro.3.speaker: Vic

vic.player.intro.4.text: Fresh off the trailer and hungry for metal... please welcome the rookie robot...
vic.player.intro.4.speaker: Vic

vic.pro.ko.1.text: It's over! I don't believe it... Juggernaut is DOWN! It's OVER!
vic.pro.ko.1.speaker: Vic

vic.pro.ko.2.text: Ladies and gentlemen... the reign is over. Your NEW BotBox champion... TERMINAL VELOCITY!
vic.pro.ko.2.speaker: Vic

vic.pro.open.text: Forty five seconds left in the championship final! This house is ON ITS FEET, and the champ is ROLLING!
vic.pro.open.speaker: Vic

vic.tonight.1.text: Tonight on BotBox... a rookie team rolls into the Box for the very first time.
vic.tonight.1.speaker: Vic

vic.tonight.2.text: Tonight on BotBox... saws, hammers, and one very nervous rookie.
vic.tonight.2.speaker: Vic

vic.tonight.3.text: Tonight on BotBox... steel meets steel, and only one walks away with the Nut.
vic.tonight.3.speaker: Vic
